name: CoreLoginPage
intent: The authentication entry page: a split-screen layout with a brand visual and an email/password sign-in form (with show/hide password, a forgot-password link, and a legal footer).
whenNot: A full-page error/permission state -> use ErrorPage
An in-app settings/account page -> use a Detail page
A multi-step onboarding/wizard -> not a login page

chooseOver.because: The LoginPage template owns the split brand/form layout, the password show/hide + forgot-password affordances, the submit loading state, and the legal footer.

regions.note: Hidden below the lg breakpoint (the form takes the full width on small screens).

regions.role: Welcome heading + subtitle above the form
Email + password fields, show/hide password toggle, forgot-password link, and the submit button
regions.note: Uses a raw <form> + Label/Input today; the Form/Field components (RHF + Zod) exist and could wire validation.

regions.role: Terms of Service / Privacy Policy links

requiredComponents.name: Button
requiredComponents.note: Submit, password toggle, forgot-password, and footer links.

onLogin.note: Callback fired on submit with the entered credentials. This template's contract is an OUTPUT callback, not input data.

dataContract.note: No data is fetched or passed in. Email/password are local state; submit emits them via onLogin. Auth (SSO/OAuth providers) is NOT part of this implementation.

states.default: Empty form; the submit button is disabled until both fields are filled.
states.loading: isLoading -> the submit shows a spinner ('Signing in...') and is disabled.
states.password-visible: The show/hide toggle reveals the password (type text vs password).

responsive.strategy: Split screen: brand visual (left 2/3) + form panel (right 1/3).

breakpoints.lg: The brand visual appears; below lg it is hidden and the form takes the full width.

allowedPlacement: route-level sign-in page (full screen, outside the app shell)
forbiddenPlacement: inside the app shell content region (it is full-screen, pre-auth)

commonMistakes.mistake: Wiring the form by hand instead of using Form/Field
commonMistakes.fix: The Form + Field components (RHF + Zod) exist and can wire validation for the login form.

commonMistakes.symptom: Expecting OAuth providers in the box
commonMistakes.fix: This implementation is email/password only; add a providers region if SSO is needed (not present today).

commonMistakes.mistake: Placing LoginPage inside the app shell
commonMistakes.symptom: A sidebar/top bar around the sign-in screen
commonMistakes.fix: Render it full-screen and pre-auth, outside CoreAppSidebar/CoreAppTopBar.

minimalExample:
import {LoginPage} from "@corensystem/coren-ui/pages/core-login-page";

<LoginPage onLogin={(email, password) => signIn(email, password)} />

evaluationCriteria.check: LoginPage chosen for the sign-in screen — not ErrorPage, a Detail page, or a wizard.
login-form renders email + password + submit; brand-visual shows at lg+.
onLogin (if provided) receives the entered email + password on submit.
submit is disabled until both fields are filled; loading state shows on submit.

notes: promotedFrom: component (library-index.json: CoreLoginPage; tier-tagged template in Stage 0)

archetypeNote: The last distinct template archetype — the System family's sign-in page (alongside ErrorPage). Component-composed (no widgets); its contract is an output callback (onLogin) rather than input data.
